### Master Directory Structure

```text
/
├── index.html                      # Entry point: Mounts the game canvas and UI overlays
├── main.js                         # Vite entry: Bootstraps the selected game module
├── package.json                    # Project dependencies (Three.js, etc.)
├── vite.config.js                  # Vite configuration for ESM/Asset handling
├── shared/                         # AAA Reusable Engine Layer
│   ├── audio/                     # Web Audio API Synthesizers (SFX & Music)
│   ├── core/                      # Game Loop, Input Manager (Keyboard/Gamepad), Physics Engine Base
│   ├── graphics/                   # Post-processing (Bloom), Particle Manager, VFX (Shake, Hit-stop, Trails)
│   ├── math/                       # Procedural Generation (Simplex/Perlin), Collision Primitives
│   ├── ui/                         # Glassmorphism Design System & UI Components
│   └── utils/                     # Object Pooling, Memory Management (.dispose() tracking), Math Helpers
└── [GameName]/                    # Isolated Game Implementation Folder
    ├── index.js                    # Game-specific entry point and lifecycle management
    ├── assets/                     # Procedural Texture Generators (Canvas API)
    ├── entities/                  # Game-specific actors (Players, Enemies, Projectiles)
    ├── scene/                      # Game-specific Three.js Scene, Lighting, and Environment setup
    └── ui/                         # Game-specific HTML/CSS Overlays and HUD logic
```
